tasks.integrated-revision: Generate Grade 6 English HL revision multiple-choice items that integrate poetry, fiction, media texts, comprehension, summary, and oral recall. Focus on identifying genre features, retrieving evidence, making simple inferences, recognising strong summaries, and switching reading strategies across mixed-genre exam questions.
tasks.exam-writing-practice: Generate Grade 6 English HL exam-style multiple-choice items about essay planning, transactional texts, editing checklists, format recall, clarity, accuracy, and time management. Emphasise planning under pressure, organising paragraphs, matching tone to audience and purpose, and spotting common grammar or punctuation traps during editing.
tasks.language-consolidation: Generate Grade 6 English HL language-consolidation multiple-choice items covering parts of speech, tense, direct and indirect speech, punctuation, and spelling in context. Emphasise sentence correction, error spotting, accurate grammar choices, and applying the year’s language structures in meaningful exam-style examples.
